WITH
product_catalog AS (
    SELECT
        "Ghi tắt",
        "Tên hàng",
        "Loại"
    FROM "sobanhang_ghi_tat"
),
sales_raw AS (
    SELECT
        "Ngày",
        "STT",
        "Khách",
        "Hàng",
        "SL" AS qty,
        "Thành tiền" AS amount,
        "Ghi chú",
        "_don_huy",
        "_tra"
    FROM "sobanhang_all"
),
sales_enriched AS (
    SELECT
        s."Ngày",
        s."STT",
        s."Khách",
        s."Hàng",
        s.qty,
        s.amount,
        s."Ghi chú",
        s."_don_huy",
        s."_tra",
        COALESCE(c."Tên hàng", s."Hàng") AS product_name,
        COALESCE(c."Ghi tắt", s."Hàng") AS product_code,
        c."Loại" AS product_group
    FROM sales_raw s
    LEFT JOIN product_catalog c
        ON LOWER(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(s."Hàng", '\s+', ' ', 'g'))) = LOWER(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(c."Ghi tắt", '\s+', ' ', 'g')))
        OR LOWER(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(s."Hàng", '\s+', ' ', 'g'))) = LOWER(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(c."Tên hàng", '\s+', ' ', 'g')))
),
final_sales AS (
    SELECT
        strftime(CAST("Ngày" AS DATE), '%Y%m') || '-' || "STT" AS order_id,
        CAST("Ngày" AS DATE) AS order_date,
        "Ngày" AS order_ts,
        product_code,
        product_group,
        product_name,
        qty,
        NULL::VARCHAR AS unit,
        amount,
        CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM("Khách")) IN ('khách lẻ', 'kl', 'lẻ', 'vãng lai', '') THEN NULL ELSE "Khách" END AS customer_id,
        CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM("Khách")) IN ('khách lẻ', 'kl', 'lẻ', 'vãng lai', '') THEN NULL ELSE "Khách" END AS customer_name,
        NULL::VARCHAR AS staff,
        NULL::VARCHAR AS channel,
        NULL::VARCHAR AS payment,
        CASE WHEN "_don_huy" = true OR "Ghi chú" LIKE '%hủy%' OR "Ghi chú" LIKE '%huỷ%' THEN true ELSE false END AS is_cancelled,
        CASE WHEN "_tra" = true OR "Ghi chú" LIKE '%trả lại%' OR "Ghi chú" LIKE '%khách trả lại%' THEN true ELSE false END AS is_returned,
        'item' AS line_kind
    FROM sales_enriched
)
SELECT * FROM final_sales
